title: relay_queue: inc_relay_attempt called before DKIM signing — attempt semantics ambiguous
description: inc_relay_attempt is called (line ~432) before DKIM signing. If DKIM fails, no network call is made — 'attempt' is counted but no delivery was tried. Consider renaming the metric or moving the call to after successful signing. Alternatively, add a separate DKIM_failure counter so the telemetry is unambiguous.
